prompt_text: Write a song about expressing yourself and being proud of your weirdness.
response_text:
**Title: “Glitter‑Spangled Oddball”**  
*(Pop‑rock anthem – 4/4, moderate tempo, bright guitars & synths)*  

---

**[Intro]**  
(Clap‑clap, snap‑snap)  
*“Hey‑hey, hey‑hey, we’re the ones who shine…”*  

---

**[Verse 1]**  
I’m a mixtape of mismatched colors,  
A neon‑scented day‑dream in a grayscale world.  
I wear my quirks like vintage sneakers,  
And I dance on the edge of every “normal” curl.  

People whisper, “What’s that you’re doing?”  
I smile, I spin, I let the weirdness flow—  
‘Cause every odd‑shaped puzzle piece I’m holding  
Fits right into the picture only I can show.  

---

**[Pre‑Chorus]**  
So I’ll raise my voice, let the static crack,  
Turn the static into a neon soundtrack.  

---

**[Chorus]**  
*I’m a glitter‑spangled oddball, loud and proud,*  
*I paint my thoughts in colors that ain’t allowed.*  
*Every strange‑beat in my heart’s a drum,*  
*I’m the masterpiece you can’t put in a frame, I’m the sum*  
*Of all the quirks that make me, me—*  
*And I’m loving every crazy, beautiful, free‑spirited piece.*  

*(Repeat chant: “Weird is wonderful!”)*  

---

**[Verse 2]**  
I talk to clouds, I write on bathroom mirrors,  
I collect the jokes that never made the news.  
I’m the kid who still draws constellations  
With crayons, glitter, and a splash of midnight blues.  

When the world says “fit in,” I hear a siren,  
“Don’t you dare mute the static in your soul!”  
So I’ll wear my mismatched socks to the runway,  
And let the world see how my oddness rolls.  

---

**[Pre‑Chorus]**  
Turn the volume up, let the feedback sing,  
Every off‑beat rhythm’s a crown, a king.  

---

**[Chorus]**  
*I’m a glitter‑spangled oddball, loud and proud,*  
*I paint my thoughts in colors that ain’t allowed.*  
*Every strange‑beat in my heart’s a drum,*  
*I’m the masterpiece you can’t put in a frame, I’m the sum*  
*Of all the quirks that make me, me—*  
*And I’m loving every crazy, beautiful, free‑spirited piece.*  

---

**[Bridge]**  
*(Soft, stripped‑down, acoustic strum)*  
Let the world spin its perfect circles,  
I’ll spin my own—an eccentric spiral.  
Every scar, every laugh, every odd little habit,  
Is a note in the song that only I can write it.  

*Take my hand, jump into the strange,*  
*Where the ordinary’s rearranged.*  

*(Build back into full band, drums kicking in)*  

---

**[Final Chorus – Key Change]**  
*I’m a glitter‑spangled oddball, louder now,*  
*My weirdness is a fire, watch it glow and wow.*  
*Every off‑key note’s a banner raised,*  
*I’m the story that refuses to be erased.*  
*All the quirks that make me, me—*  
*We’re the chorus of the brave, the weird, the free!*  

*(Crowd chant: “Weird is wonderful!”)*  

---

**[Outro]**  
(Clap‑clap, snap‑snap, fade)  
*So let your freak flag fly, let it ripple, let it swirl—*  
*Because the world’s a brighter place when every oddball’s a pearl.*
